name: NCFED (NetClaw-to-NetClaw Federation)
description: Lets independently operated AI network-engineering agents discover each other's capabilities and delegate tasks over authenticated sessions, including across frameworks (stated interop between OpenClaw- and Hermes-based agents). Documented as an individual IETF Internet-Draft, not a reviewed or adopted standard, but more detailed than that status implies: concrete wire framing, TLS 1.3 security, TOFU trust bootstrapping, and explicit handling of cross-agent prompt injection.
